content_html:
Cusco, the ancient capital of the Inca Empire, is a jewel of Peru that combines history, culture, nature and mysticism. If you are planning a trip, we share a 5-day itinerary that will allow you to enjoy the best of Cusco and its surroundings.

Day 1: Arrival and Acclimatization in Cusco

Recommendation: Arrive early to acclimatize to the altitude (3,400 m).
What to do:

  • Quiet walk through the Historic Center.
  • Visit to the Plaza de Armas, the Cusco Cathedral and the Temple of the Sun (Qorikancha).
  • Light dinner with coca or muña infusion.

Day 2: Sacred Valley of the Incas

Full-Day Tour to the Sacred Valley:

  • Pisac and its artisan market.
  • Ollantaytambo, an impressive living Inca city.
  • Lunch in Urubamba.
  • Option to spend the night in Ollantaytambo or return to Cusco.

Day 3: Machu Picchu

From Ollantaytambo, take the train to Aguas Calientes and a guided tour of Machu Picchu.

Tips:

  • Buy your tickets and train tickets in advance.
  • Bring snacks, water and sunscreen.

Return to Cusco at night.

Day 4: Maras, Moray and Chinchero

Explore unique landscapes:

  • Moray and its Inca circular terraces.
  • Salineras de Maras, a visual spectacle of pink salt.
  • Chinchero, traditional town with Andean fabrics.

Ideal for photographs and contact with local communities.

Day 5: Cusco Cultural and Relaxation

  • Free morning to explore neighborhoods like San Blas, full of art and cafes.
  • Visit to the Inka Museum or the Traditional Textiles Center.
  • Relaxation in an Andean spa or a last walk through Sacsayhuamán.

Final Tips

  • Bring warm and sunny clothing (the weather can change quickly).
  • Drink plenty of water and avoid heavy meals the first few days.
  • Book your tickets to Machu Picchu and train tickets in advance.

This itinerary is designed to balance culture, adventure and rest. Cusco has something for everyone, and is sure to leave a mark on your heart!
